shortDescription: US coffee chain Starbucks NASDAQ:SBUX plans to set up a global capability centre (GCC) in the southern Indian city of Chennai, creating roughly 800 jobs in the first phase, a government source said on Monday.Starbucks did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
